texto: To leave errands at home or at work, direct, but short, mandatory phrases are used: «Haal straks brood en melk, alsjeblieft» (then bring bread and milk, please). «Boodschappen doen» means shopping the home, and adverbs like «straks» (within a while / then) and «even» (a moment) are time-sensitive.

frases.nl: Tom, ik ben even naar de winkel.
frases.es: Tom, voy un momento a la tienda.
frases.en: Tom, I'm going to the store for a minute.
analisis: to the shop; way to the store

frases.en: What do I have to do?

frases.nl: Haal straks brood en melk, alsjeblieft.
frases.es: Compra luego pan y leche, por favor.
frases.en: Then buy bread and milk, please.

frases.nl: Op tafel, naast de blauwe tas.
frases.es: En la mesa, junto al bolso azul.
frases.en: On the table, next to the blue bag.

bloques.pregunta: What order does Noor ask Tom to do in a little while?

opciones.texto: Buy or bring bread and milk
Clean the living room and take out the trash
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't have any cleaning tasks.

opciones.texto: Cooking the vegetable soup for dinner
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't ask you to cook, but to bring bread and milk.

bloques.pregunta: Where's Noor gone for a second?
bloques.frase: Tom, ik ben even naar de winkel.

opciones.explicacion: «Naar de winkel» indicates its rapid exit into trade.
He's not going to the library, he's going to the store.

opciones.texto: To the train station to pick up a friend.
opciones.explicacion: He's going shopping at the store.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the second food requested by Noor.

opciones.explicacion: He has to bring in bread and milk («melk»).
He's not asking for cheese, he's asking for milk.

bloques.pregunta: Where can Tom find Noor's key?
bloques.frase: Op tafel, naast de blauwe tas.

opciones.texto: On the table, next to the blue bag.
opciones.explicacion: «Op tafel, naast de blauwe tas» specifies the exact place.

opciones.texto: In the outer lock of the main door
opciones.explicacion: He didn't leave it on the lock.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the object necessary to open and close the house.

bloques.frase: Tom, ik ben even naar de winkel
bloques.traduccion: Tom, I've been to the store for a moment.
bloques.explicacion: Initial voice, subject with temporary warning «even» and prepositional direction synthma.

intro: He reproduces and interprets short domestic notes with orders, purchases and items for daily use.
